summary.text: Nikki McDonald is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 49 since December 2023 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026. A consultant and former teacher, she founded and led the Olathe Public Education Network.

paragraphs.text: McDonald was born in Little Rock, Arkansas, and earned a bachelor's degree in 1997 and a graduate degree in 1998 from the University of Arkansas.
Her career experience includes working as a consultant, and she previously worked as a teacher and as founder, executive director, and president of the Olathe Public Education Network.

Ballotpedia lists her as affiliated with organizations including the Project 10/20 Emergency Homeless Shelter, the Shawnee Mission Unitarian Universalist Church, and the Johnson County Mental Health Advisory Board.
The Democratic Party of Kansas appointed McDonald to the Kansas House on December 18, 2023, to replace Representative Brad Boyd, and she was sworn in on December 20, 2023.
During the 2025-2026 session she served on the Financial Institutions and Pensions, Health and Human Services, and K-12 Education Budget committees.
